skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze concepts and approaches in tourism geography research.
Analyze and evaluate valuable resources for tourism development and infrastructure systems.
Analyze geographical characteristics of continents, regions, and countries around the world.
Analyze geographical characteristics of tourism in Vietnam and its regions.
Practically apply skills to analyze statistical information on resources, infrastructure, and technical facilities for tourism development.
Develop sales strategies at tourist destinations based on cross-selling, upselling, and after-sales service strategies.
Demonstrate awareness, responsibility, and creativity in learning processes.
Show responsibility towards natural and cultural environments, with positive attitudes towards protecting and using tourism resources sustainably.
